punchline: Three castaways stayed on a rock with a spring that was underwater half the day, and the rescue ship did come back for them.
thirty_sec: In December 1820 the starving crew of the whaleship Essex found a spring on an island, but it lay under six feet of sea at high tide. Within days the island's food ran short, and the boats set out again. Three men chose to stay, because their odds there looked better. The others promised to send help, and when they reached Chile the United States consul at Valparaiso hired the ship Surrey. She found all three alive.
